problem_statement: The functions ipv4_hdr_set_ihl() and ipv4_hdr_get_ihl() must handle the IPv4 Internet Header Length as a byte length. Setting the length to 20 bytes must result in an IHL value of 5, and setting it to 60 bytes must result in 15, without changing the version part of the same header byte. Reading the IHL must return 20 bytes when the stored IHL value is 5 and 60 bytes when it is 15. The current implementations give incorrect results for these values.
